title: Martinfish is BACK (feat. wintrcat)
summary: Martinfish returns at an 80:20 ratio (80% top engine move, 20% Martin move, random and hidden), built by wintrcat. Player (white, London vs ...c5/...Qb6 critical line with Na3 idea) nearly loses the exchange mid-game, then a Martin move hands over the queen ('give me the queen'), and the player converts with a run of checks to mate. Won.
